lines.en: The familiar scents of salt water and sunscreen flood my senses as I look to the sky in search of respite from the expected accompanying visual stimulation.
There is only so much my senses can take at once, and that is precisely why I need to be careful in places like this.
The girls of class 1-A now are not the same girls they were in the past.
And seeing as a good portion of that (if not all of it) is my fault, I must remain vigilant. I must remain abstinent so as not to further contaminate them.
...is what I would be saying if I had not already given up and succumbed to the incessant lust that governs this [[comparably] hulking body.
I am going to have so much weird and impure sex this weekend. I sure hope there’s no god present to smite me.
: Wow! The weather’s so great today that it might even lessen the impact of whatever impending drama currently hangs over us like clouds!
: Couldn’t have said it better myself, Ayane.
: Woah! We’ve even got an ominous floating caption that potentially foreshadows our impending doom! So fun!
: I’m just glad I’m not the only one who can see it.
: Senpai! Senpai!~
: You actually came! Not that I was worried you wouldn’t or anything. But now that you’re here, I’m definitely way less nervous and flighty! Probably just a coincidence.
: Hi, Miss Imai. I am here as well, and I am extending my need for attention to you too since you are just girl-Sensei.
: Dude, what have I ever done to deserve that sort of slander?
: Imani, I don’t think you’re allowed to like me and also say things like that at the same time.
: Racism! You think you can tell me what I can and can’t do just because I’m black, don’t you?!
: How many times are you going to play that card? You know that makes literally zero difference to me.
: Oh, sorry. My b. Let me try again.
: Sexism! You think you can tell me what I can and can’t do just because I’m a woman, don’t you?!
: Hah...
: You should really be more accepting of girl-Sensei, boy-Sensei. Your species might even die out at this rate. I only know three of you with character models.
: Is that a caption I see floating away over there?
: No, just the last remaining segment of the fourth wall. Status report, Imani.
: Only if I get to subsequently debrief you at the end of the day! And Ayane — you didn’t hear that!
: Can I help?
: No. You already have Makoto.
: Oh, right. I want to hear more about Ayane’s sudden lesbian side before this conversation proceeds.
: No! Status report is as follows: we are on the beach! Most of us, at least!
: And later, we will be in our respective bedrooms! Which we are not sharing despite how much I tried to make that happen this year.
: And again, Ayane — you didn’t hear that!
: We all know about you and Sensei already, Miss Imai. You don’t need to hide it.
: Aww!~ They’ve already given us their blessing, Senpai! We should stage a fake announcement in front of the class and have one of the girls film it so we can go viral.
: Now, I never said I was giving you my- ahh! Sensei?! Did you just push me?!
: No, that was the caption.
: It wasn’t the- oh my God, it is! Ah! Back! Back, I say! I have a gun!
The caption chases Ayane down the beach, leaving just Imani and me. And everyone in the background. Mostly Imani and me.
: Anyway, I’d love to stay and chat more, but I’m organizing a volleyball thing with Karin later and I’ve gotta go help her with that. Come find me tonight, maybe?
: Like, sexually?
: Well, yeah. If I’m gonna debrief you, it sure as hell ain’t gonna be platonic.
: Sensei!
: Dad!
: Oh, okay. I guess it’s your turn now.
: Hi! Yes. Come hang out with us. Preferably without your shirt on. But only because I am worried about you overheating.
: Imani already left if that’s what you’re worried about right now.
: Then, please take your shirt off because you are hot and I want to touch you.
: I have also always secretly wanted to touch your abs, so let the record show that I support Chika’s suggestion.
: Didn’t you just call him your dad?
: Yes. But let the record show that this doesn’t make things weird because I’ve never actually had a dad, so calling Sensei “Dad” isn’t taboo at all and is actually just fun.
: Woo! No dad club!
: That’s like half of the class, I think.
: Right! Which means we need to find an advisor if we want to make things formal. Which we do! Right now! So come shirtlessly resolve our respective daddy issues!
: Can I at least finish greeting everyone at the beach first? I literally just got here.
: Fine. But only since doing so is your moral obligation.
: Great. Then I’ll start with Otoha, who is currently approaching us.
: What?
: Hey.
: Am I...interrupting something?
: Yes.
: No, Otoha. You are not interrupting anything. And thank you for saving me the steps required to come say hello to you.
: Do you need something from Sensei, Otoha? I’ve never seen you go out of your way just to say hi to him before.
: Don’t talk to her, Rin. She’ll destroy you again.
: You’re still being weird about that? That was like, forever ago.
: Yet the wounds still remain.
: Do they? Because Rin seems pretty cool with me. And, if I remember correctly, at least I gave her a shot when she confessed.
: She’s got a point, Chika. And the wound you left probably did sting a little harder since I liked you for so long. Not that it was actually your fault or anything, though.
: That was different! I already had somebody!
: Wooooah, really? Who could it have possibly been?
: Do you know, Sensei? Because I have absolutely nooooo idea who Chika might have feelings for if not my ex-girlfriend. I am in a state of complete and utter cluelessness.
: Before Chika kills you, is there actually something you need, Otoha? Or are you really just saying hi?
: Yeah. I’m invoking my privilege as your cool older sister to rescue you from these two girls who clearly want to use your body for their own nefarious purposes.
: But I like it when my body is used for nefarious purposes.
: Then kindly ask them to hold it in for like thirty minutes while I yell at you for being such an idiot. Which is another privilege I have as your cool older sister.
: So are you just going to cozy up to everyone I love, or what?
: Maybe. I can’t find Yumi, though. Have you seen her anywhere? I’ve decided to date her next.
: So that’s...the path you’re taking, Otoha?
: What- dating Yumi? That was a joke. There are only like two girls in our class I’d consider dating and I’ve already tried that with one of them.
: Wait. Who’s the other one then?
: Don’t ask her, Rin! That makes it sound like you’re interested!
: Maya.
: Ohhhh! Yeah, I get it.
: Don’t “get it” either! What is that supposed to mean?!
: I can just totally see those two together.
: Just what the hell is going on with you and Maya behind my back?
: Nothing, unfortunately. At least outside of my dreams.
: Enough chit-chat, though! You’re coming with me.
: H-Hey! Otoha! Who do you think are just stealing people away from...other people all the time! Bring Sensei back here! Rin and I have daddy issues that need to be resolved!
: Yeah, and I need to go resolve them.
: Maybe trying to resolve your own issues first would be a better idea, hm?
: Ugh, but that’s so hard.
: The best things in life normally are.
: Ahh. You mean like a penis.
: Yup. The best thing in life is definitely the penis. That’s why I’ve only had romantic feelings for girls.
: There’s a spark between us, Otoha. I know you can feel it too.
: Mhm. And I can’t control it anymore! Please! Take me, Sensei! Right now!
: Chika, as a fellow Sensei-liker, do you ever find yourself fantasizing about Sensei with other girls?
: Specifically girls you have dated before? And that, instead of actively participating in said fantasy, you’re sort of just off to the side watching and touching yourself?
: See! I told you she was going to destroy you again! Keep that whore out of your fantasies and just...put some other girl in there instead! One you like more! Who won’t hurt you!
: You mean, like...Futaba?
: Not like Futaba!
: Otoha — we’ve been walking for five minutes and I haven’t “taken” you yet. When do we get to that part?
: Whenever my last ounce of self-respect has faded away. So, I don’t know — another month or two, maybe?
: Fine. I’ll wait. But I’m formally requesting that you wear that swimsuit when I do get to take you because it does a great job of accentuating your surprisingly hot body.
: Why is my hotness surprising to you?
: I think it’s mostly just because you’re always wearing pants. Which is probably another reason I like your pajamas so much.
: Really laying it on thick today, huh? Has not having your childhood girlfriend around to relieve you every morning finally driven you mad?
: Tch. I was worried that’s where we were heading.
: She told you, didn’t she?
: She told me a lot. Way more than I’d expect her to given our...history. But, you’ll be proud to know that I did not attempt to kiss her while she was at her most vulnerable this time.
: Yeah, you’re too busy liking Maya instead now.
: Not at all. Niki will always be my number one. She’s the perfect girl, after all.
: Wow. I feel a lot better now, Otoha. Thank you.
: I think you’re misunderstanding something, Sensei. I don’t want to make you feel better.
: I want you to know that you’re the biggest idiot in the whole wide world for letting a girl like that get away! Were you dropped on your head as a child? Because it sure seems like it!
: Oh, look! We’re finally here!
: Finally where? I don’t see-
: Sit.
Otoha darts behind me and pushes me onto...
A fucking banana boat.
: Did we really walk all the way over here just to talk on a giant banana again?
: I figured that being called an idiot on top of a giant, buoyant fruit would lessen the impact on your already minuscule self-esteem.
: Yeah, I might as well replace my couch with one at this point. Now, go on. Hit me. Say all you need to say about how much I fucked things up.
: I will! But first, let me congratulate you!
: I truly believed it was impossible to disappoint so many people at once. But you managed to disappoint millions by breaking a famous idol and essentially forcing her into retirement!
: It’s a new high score! You finally did it! You just now have to live with the weight of never being able to surpass it. So it’s all downhill from here, buddy.
: Yeah, well...if it makes you feel better, I’m definitely not happy with myself.
: Now, why the ever-loving fuck would that make me feel better?
: Beats me. But you’re smiling pretty fucking aggressively right now, so I can only imagine you’re enjoying this.
: I am smiling out of sheer disbelief, not joy.
: Like, I always knew you’d manage to fuck things up with her, sure. But having her walk in on you fucking her little sister is, like...what? Really? You’re starting with the killing blow?

: So not only is the love of her life cheating on her, but he’s cheating on her with a teenager. And not only is she a teenager, it’s her little sister. You couldn’t write a soap opera more dramatic than that.
: Wouldn’t it have made more sense to cheat on her with an adult first? You know? Sort of ease her into the fact that you’re an insatiable pervert who’ll fuck anything that moves?
: Otoha, I don’t know what you want me to say here. I can’t justify it. I can’t even explain it. But it happened, and now I’m paying the price.
: It’s not just Niki who left either. Ami’s gone too. She’s been staying at the dorms ever since it happened.
: So Niki’s just not coming to your place at all anymore? Because she told me she was.
: She stops by to pick things up and do laundry, but she doesn’t talk to me. She doesn’t even look at me. I’ve been entirely alone in there, and it’s driving me insane.
: Or...more insane, I guess. There’s sort of a baseline level of insanity that can be assumed in regard to me since my track record shows me doing shit like this all the time.
: Well, if it makes you feel any better, you are definitely not the only one suffering. In fact, if anything, I’d say Niki has it like ten times worse than you.
: Because you’re still out here having fun and flirting with girls. She hasn’t even been able to practice lately. So her entire album is on hold right now while she “recovers.”
: Still has time to meet with you, though.
: Yeah. But my singing lessons have essentially turned into “Otoha’s counseling hour” where I just watch her cry and internally debate whether or not I should pat her on the back or something.
: You have fucked that girl up. And I don’t think time alone is going to fix that, Sensei.
: But, at the same time, I don’t think I’ve ever seen Noriko happier. Just that happiness comes at the cost of the rift you sowed between her and Niki. So, like...what the fuck?
: I don’t want to be in the middle of this. But I feel like I have to at this point or Niki will essentially just remain invisible to you and things will never get better.
: What now, then?
: Dude, you tell me. I can’t fix this for you. But I don’t want to just sit around while my favorite lopsided power couple breaks up either.
: Can’t you just...talk to her?
: And disregard her wishes? Sure. But she told me she wants space, so that’s what I’ll give her.
: Isn’t fucking her sister sort of “disregarding her wishes” as well? Or is that a wish you were just okay with disregarding because you got something out of it?
: It wasn’t just...something, Otoha. I wasn’t thinking about Niki when it happened. Just Noriko. And Noriko’s been silently suffering forever because of me.
: She’s actually like a sister to me. She didn’t just start pretending to be one like you are now.
: Was that really necessary?...
: I don’t know...I’ve got no fucking clue.
: You really think I’d spend this much time and energy on you if I was just pretending?...
: I’m an only child, Sensei. I don’t have the luxury of actually knowing what it’s like to be a sibling. Or the history of growing up beside you. So are my feelings just invalid because of that?
: No...they’re not.
: I just have a hard time figuring out who’s being authentic and who isn’t. So I sort of assume everyone isn’t by default.
: Why though? Who do you actually know that isn’t authentic? Because everyone I know that you know genuinely cares. Too much even.
: Nowadays, no one. But this outlook isn’t exactly new. A lot of shit happened to me well before you were even born, Otoha.
: Okay. But are you really going to let that define you for the rest of your pathetic existence? Just fucking grow up, dude. The past is the past. Niki’s here now. And she needs you.
: No, I need her.
: No. She needs you.
: She was fine without me for-
: She was absolutely not fine without you for years. She was an obsessive loner who became engulfed in her work out of sheer spite toward you.
: She was never happy. Never comfortable. And she drifted from hotel room to hotel room every single night, waiting for the slightest hint that you still gave a shit.
: And even now, after you have done the worst possible thing to her, she is still obsessed and still wants to figure out how to make something that will never work work.
: That is true codependency. Not this “moping around and helping teenage girls resolve their daddy issues” bullshit you’re already on after being here for twenty minutes.
: Just go to her. Show her that you still care.
: And then what? Hurt her again?

: Yeah. Hurt her again. As many times as you have to. Because it might not seem like it, but that’s better for her than just being indefinitely neglected when she has sworn to be yours for the rest of her life.
: I just don’t want her to be like that anymore, Otoha. I want her to move on and find someone who won’t hurt her. Then I can just...hurt in her place.
: Well, tough fucking shit because that’s not how her stupid obsessive idol brain works. Niki will die with a body-count of one if you never see her again.
: How's she supposed to find someone else when her taste in men is just “the worst man on earth?” Because there can only be one worst man on earth, and that man is clearly you.
: You really do know exactly what to say to make all of my troubles fade away, Otoha.
: Sensei. You are making a mistake.
: You don’t like being away from her. She doesn’t like being away from you. Fuck her space. Fuck your moping. Just...tell her you’re sorry and fuck her sister in private from now on.
: Do you really think she’s that dependent on me?
: A thousand times yes. And I’m low-key worried that something in the water is causing it because your fucking weirdo niece is the same exact way and everyone else is slowly becoming like that too.
: Daughter.
